description: Identifies non-partitioning surfaces that are neither fins nor surfaces with holes in a Triangle Mesh or Geological Model Meshes object.

hole_size_ratio_tolerance.description: A boundary line is considered a hole if the ratio of the hole bounding box diagonal to the mesh bounding box diagonal is smaller than this tolerance.

max_area_ratio.description: Components with surface area larger than the largest component times this ratio are ignored.
